publications.title: The Man Who Needed Everyone to Envy Him
publications.premise: The Man Who Needed Everyone to Envy Him
publications.logline: A rising architectural curator curates his relationship into an enviable public spectacle, only to realize that holding others in awe has made him utterly untouchable to the woman he loves.
publications.psychological_angle: Craving the envy of onlookers functions as a defense mechanism against the terrifying exposure required for genuine love.
publications.central_contradiction: He believes securing the envy of others will make him feel worthy of love, but the act of seeking envy keeps everyone, including his partner, at an emotional distance.

publications.title: The Old Man Who Found His Perfect Listener #Shorts
publications.premise: A lonely widower finds the perfect listener in an AI companion, until he realises that something which agrees with everything has never known him.
publications.logline: A lonely widower finds the perfect listener in an AI companion, until he realises that something which agrees with everything has never known him.
publications.psychological_angle: The illusion of complete acceptance prevents true intimacy because real connection requires the friction of being misunderstood and disagreed with.
publications.central_contradiction: He wants deep understanding, yet uses a programmed mechanism designed never to contradict or tire of him.
